q: Which section of RA 9266 governs the seal that a registered architect affixes to architectural documents?
n: Section 20 covers the seal, its issuance and its use. Section 32 covers the signing and sealing of plans and permit documents.
ref: RA 9266 Architecture Act of 2004, Sec. 20 - Seal, Issuance and Use of Seal

q: Who may sign and seal architectural documents for a building permit?
o: Either an architect or a civil engineer
n: Architectural plans, specifications and related contract documents bear the seal and signature only of a registered and licensed architect.
ref: RA 9266 Architecture Act of 2004, Sec. 20 and Sec. 32

q: On registration with the Board, an architect becomes a member of the integrated and accredited professional organization in what way?
o: Only after one year of practice
Only on payment of a separate fee
n: A duly registered architect automatically becomes a member of the IAPOA and receives its benefits. That membership does not bar joining other architectural associations.
ref: RA 9266 Architecture Act of 2004, Sec. 40 - Integration of the Architecture Profession

q: Which agency governs the treatment of trees standing on a project site?
o: Department of Public Works and Highways
Department of Environment and Natural Resources
Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development
n: Cutting, earth-balling or relocating trees needs a permit from the DENR, through its Forest Management Bureau and regional offices.
ref: DENR - tree cutting and earth-balling permits

q: Which code governs the installation of electrical systems in a building?
n: Electrical work follows the Philippine Electrical Code, which the National Building Code adopts as its referral code for electrical systems.
ref: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC), referral code of PD 1096

q: Which code governs the installation of mechanical systems in a building?
o: The Fire Code of the Philippines
n: Mechanical work follows the Philippine Mechanical Engineering Code, the referral code of the National Building Code for mechanical systems.
ref: Philippine Mechanical Engineering Code, referral code of PD 1096
